description: This file contains the implementation of the ThemeManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing themes, rendering theme hooks, and handling theme-related hooks and variables.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Theme\ThemeManager
classes.description: Provides the default implementation of a theme manager in Drupal, handling theme registration, rendering, hook invocation, and theme variable management.

methods.name: setThemeRegistry
methods.description: Sets the theme registry used for rendering.

methods.name: getActiveTheme
methods.description: Returns the current active theme, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: hasActiveTheme
methods.description: Checks if there is an active theme set.

methods.name: resetActiveTheme
methods.description: Resets the active theme and default variables.

methods.name: setActiveTheme
methods.description: Sets the active theme and loads it via theme initialization.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a theme hook with variables, handling fallback, preprocessing, and template rendering.

methods.name: buildThemeHookSuggestions
methods.description: Builds theme hook suggestions based on hook name and variables.

methods.name: initTheme
methods.description: Initializes the active theme based on route match.

methods.name: invokeAllWith
methods.description: Invokes a callback for all theme hook implementations in the theme chain.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Invokes a specific hook implementation for a theme.

methods.name: alterForTheme
methods.description: Applies alterations for a theme, hook type, and data.

methods.name: getImplementationsForTheme
methods.description: Retrieves hook implementations for a specific theme and hook.

methods.name: getThemeChain
methods.description: Returns the list of theme and base themes in reverse order.

methods.name: alter
methods.description: Applies theme alterations for the current active theme.

methods.name: getDefaultTemplateVariables
methods.description: Returns default variables for templates, allowing modules to alter them.

methods.name: getThemeEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a theme engine by name.
